I'm a retired signals operator. I served on the front lines in Afghanistan. I was trained in counter-insurgency by some of the best officers the Canadian Forces ever produced. What I'm about to tell you is not theory. It's what I was trained to recognize.

When I served, we operated under what's called 4th generation warfare. That means insurgency — irregular fighters, IEDs, ambushes, propaganda. The Taliban. You could see the enemy. You knew who was trying to kill you. The rules were ugly but they were clear.
What's happening now is something different. Something worse.
There is a concept called 5th generation warfare , and you need to understand it — not because it's some military buzzword, but because it is being used on you right now.

Here's what it means in plain English: Instead of shooting you, they capture your institutions — your government, your courts, your media, your schools — and use them to destroy you slowly. They use your own tax dollars to do it. They rewrite your history. They demonize your symbols. They pathologize your dissent. And the whole time, you don't even realize you're under attack because the people…

The people who employ these tactics against their own domestic population are sick in the head . There is no other way to say it. Normal, healthy human beings do not wage war against the people they are supposed to serve.
The Taliban killed 165 Canadians in 13 years. Our own government's MAID program kills that many in days .

The Kaiser, Hitler, the Chinese communists, the Taliban — none of them come close to the body count our own government is racking up against its own people. And they're on track to exceed every single war death in Canadian history combined.
That's not healthcare. That's warfare. You just can't see the uniforms.
